tasks.title: Nine sections, not one
tasks.objective: Replace plan save's substring test for '## Surface Impact' with a parse_sections check over all nine planner sections, naming every missing one.
acceptance_criteria: plan save refuses a plan missing any of Problem, Scope / Non-goals, Acceptance Criteria, Technical Approach, Decisions, Surface Impact, Task Decomposition, Risks, Verify Plan.
A section present with a whitespace-only body counts as missing, decided by parse_sections rather than a length threshold.
The refusal names every missing section in one message, not the first one found.
The check calls factory_lib.parse_sections; no second section matcher is added to plans.py.
The rule binds at SAVE time and only to plan documents. plans/README.md, plans/assumptions.md and plans/deferrals.md are a readme and two ledgers, not plans, and are never checked.

Archived plans under plans/completed/ are NOT rewritten to satisfy a rule invented after they shipped — FORGE-INIT-1 is missing eight sections and harness-v2-wedge five, and rewriting them would falsify the record. A test asserts an archived plan is left alone.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "plan_save or plan_sections"
tasks.reviewer_focus: That the rule binds where plans are WRITTEN, not everywhere plan-shaped files live. The first version of this task would have rewritten shipped, archived plans to satisfy a contract invented after they were saved.

tasks.title: Bind the decomposition to its plan, and make task fields mean something
tasks.objective: Stamp project, story, epic, plan_file and the plan digest into the decomposition from run.json and the roadmap, refuse a digest that does not match the active plan, and validate verify_commands and dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: The recorder writes project, story, epic, plan_file and plan_sha256 from .factory/run.json and plans/roadmap.json; agent-supplied values for those keys are dropped, not merged.
A decomposition whose plan_sha256 does not match the active plan file is refused, so this handover is digest-bound like every other one.
Artifacts recorded before this change stay readable: the new fields are optional in the schema and .factory/history/ artifacts still parse.
Every task's verify_commands entry is checked with doctor.unrunnable_reason; prose is refused and a real command passes.
required_tests may be [] and the task is still accepted, provided verify_commands is runnable.
A dependencies entry naming a later task in the array is refused; array order stays the execution sequence.
The recorder refuses when the roadmap has no story matching run.json rather than inventing an epic.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "decomposition or provenance or unrunnable"
tasks.reviewer_focus: That promoting doctor.unrunnable_reason from advisory output to a refusal path does not change what it accepts for doctor's existing caller.

tasks.title: Retire authored waves
tasks.objective: Stop anything authoring build_waves and delete its only reader in the same change, keeping the schema field optional so shipped artifacts still parse.
acceptance_criteria: build_waves is gone from factory/prompts/decomposer.md's output contract and from griller.md's checklist.
factory/scripts/render_linear_task_graph.py is deleted in this same task, so the field never exists as a writer without a reader or the reverse.
build_waves stays optional in factory/schemas/decomposition.json and the .factory/history/ artifacts carrying it still parse.
Nothing else references render_linear_task_graph: a repo-wide search returns no callers, and check_dual_runtime stays green.
The change cites decision 0021 derived-ordering, or restates the ordering claim if that record has not landed.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "waves or decomposer or history"
tasks.reviewer_focus: That the writer and the reader die together. Split across tasks, one of them is an orphan by construction.
